INSERT INTO rdf_edges (s, p, o_id, graph_id) SELECT DISTINCT _ge.c1, _ge.c2, _ge.c3, ? FROM (SELECT n0.node_id c1, ? c2, n1.node_id c3
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_edges e2 ON e2.s = n0.node_id AND e2.p = ?
JOIN nodes n1 ON n1.node_id = e2.o_id) AS _ge WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rdf_edges _gx WHERE _gx.s = _ge.c1 AND _gx.p = _ge.c2 AND _gx.o_id = _ge.c3 AND COALESCE(_gx.graph_id, '') = COALESCE(?, ''))

DELETE FROM rdf_edges WHERE edge_id IN (SELECT e2.edge_id
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_edges e2 ON e2.s = n0.node_id AND e2.p = ?
JOIN nodes n1 ON n1.node_id = e2.o_id) AND edge_id <= ?

INSERT INTO rdf_edges (s, p, o_id, graph_id, qualifiers) SELECT DISTINCT _ge.c1, _ge.c2, _ge.c3, ?, ? FROM (SELECT n0.node_id c1, ? c2, n1.node_id c3
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_edges e2 ON e2.s = n0.node_id AND e2.p = ?
JOIN nodes n1 ON n1.node_id = e2.o_id) AS _ge WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rdf_edges _gx WHERE _gx.s = _ge.c1 AND _gx.p = _ge.c2 AND _gx.o_id = _ge.c3 AND COALESCE(_gx.graph_id, '') = COALESCE(?, '')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rdf_edges WHERE s = _ge.c1 AND p = ? AND o_id = _ge.c3)

SELECT CASE WHEN e3.qualifiers IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SQLUser.JSON_VALUE(e3.qualifiers, '$.name') END AS t2_name
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_edges e2 ON e2.s = n0.node_id AND e2.p = ?
JOIN nodes n1 ON n1.node_id = e2.o_id
JOIN rdf_edges e3 ON e3.s = n0.node_id AND e3.p = ? AND e3.o_id = n1.node_id

INSERT INTO nodes (node_id) SELECT DISTINCT _cg._nid FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|' || COALESCE(CAST(n0.%ID AS VARCHAR(20)), '') AS _nid
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.label = ?
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL) AS _cg

INSERT INTO rdf_labels (s, label) SELECT DISTINCT _cg._nid, ? FROM (SELECT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|' || COALESCE(CAST(n0.%ID AS VARCHAR(20)), '') AS _nid
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.label = ?
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL) AS _cg

INSERT INTO rdf_edges (s, p, o_id, graph_id) SELECT DISTINCT _ge.c1, _ge.c2, _ge.c3, ? FROM (SELECT n0.node_id c1, ? c2, n2.node_id c3
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.label = ?
CROSS JOIN nodes n2
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL AND n2.node_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|' || COALESCE(CAST(n0.%ID AS VARCHAR(20)), '')) AS _ge WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rdf_edges _gx WHERE _gx.s = _ge.c1 AND _gx.p = _ge.c2 AND _gx.o_id = _ge.c3 AND COALESCE(_gx.graph_id, '') = COALESCE(?, ''))

INSERT INTO nodes (node_id, graph_id) SELECT DISTINCT ?, '' FROM (SELECT 1 AS _one
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.label = ?
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL) AS _cg WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nodes WHERE node_id = ? AND COALESCE(graph_id, '') = '')

INSERT INTO rdf_labels (s, label) SELECT DISTINCT ?, ? FROM (SELECT 1 AS _one

INSERT INTO rdf_props (s, "key", val) SELECT DISTINCT ?, ?, ? FROM (SELECT 1 AS _one
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.label = ?
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL) AS _cg WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rdf_props WHERE s = ? AND "key" = ? AND COALESCE(graph_id, '') = '')

INSERT INTO rdf_edges (s, p, o_id, graph_id) SELECT DISTINCT _ge.c1, _ge.c2, _ge.c3, ? FROM (SELECT n0.node_id c1, ? c2, ? c3
FROM nodes n0
JOIN rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.label = ?

SELECT '{"type":"' || e4.p || '","props":' || COALESCE(e4.qualifiers, '{}') || '}' AS r
FROM nodes n0

CROSS JOIN nodes n2
JOIN rdf_labels l3 ON l3.s = n2.node_id AND l3.label = ?
